title: ApiSpec
description: Interface specification for all functions exposed by a module. Source of truth for test spec and cross-spec linting. Version 2.0.0.

typeRef.description: A type name: primitive, entity name, enum name, or array thereof (e.g. 'string', 'User', 'OrderStatus', 'OrderItem[]'). Use 'void' for functions that return nothing.

type.description: The type of this parameter. Must resolve to a primitive, entity, or enum in DataSpec.

required.description: Whether this parameter is required. Default: true.

example.description: A concrete example value for this parameter.

condition.description: Human-readable description of when this error is thrown.

returnType.description: What the caller receives: exception class name, HTTP status, or error shape.

fnId.description: Unique identifier for an API function

version.description: Semver version of this api document instance.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the ApiSpec schema this document conforms to. Must be '2.0.0'.

module.description: Must match the module name in the corresponding data spec.

description.description: High-level description of this API spec module. Summarizes the module's purpose and scope.

dataSpecVersion.description: Version of the data spec this API spec was authored against. Used for drift detection.

functions.description: All functions exposed by this module.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this function, e.g. 'FN-placeOrder'. Used by data spec apiRef and test spec fnRef.

name.description: camelCase function name as it appears in code.

description.description: One sentence: what this function does.

entity.description: Entity this function primarily operates on. Must match an entity name in the data spec.

type.description: The return type of this function. Must resolve to a primitive, entity, or enum in DataSpec, or void.

example.description: A concrete example of the return value.

Type.description: Must resolve to a type in DataSpec, or void.

visibility.description: Whether this function is exposed externally or internal only.

pure.description: True if this function has no side effects (same input always yields same output). Informs test strategy.

priority.description: Implementation priority. P0 = must have, P1 = should have, P2 = could have, P3 = won't have now.

reqRefs.description: REQ-IDs from GoalSpec that this function implements. Populated during architecture phase. Use for FN→REQ traceability. At least one must be present once requirements are known.

nfrRefs.description: NFR-IDs from GoalSpec that this function helps satisfy (e.g. performance, reliability).

type.description: The type of the function parameter or return value.

example.description: A concrete example value for this field.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in this API spec.

apiSpecVersion.description: Version of this API spec (independent of the API version).
